pages.title: Cellar
pages.creator: ApriCate Studio
pages.description: Cellar is a cheese-aging tycoon game about balancing quick sales with more valuable stock. Make cheese, store it on shelves, and decide when to sell. Hire apprentices and dig additional rooms as your cellar grows and the cheeses mature in real time.

pages.title: Hotshift
pages.creator: Loose Bolt Games
pages.description: Hotshift combines vertical movement with temperature matching. Hold to rise while becoming hot enough to pass orange barriers, then release to fall and turn cold for blue ones. Time both your height and temperature to get through the next opening.

pages.title: Glam Guru Puzzle Collection
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Glam Guru Puzzle Collection brings together small fashion-themed challenges. Use clicks and dragging to work through tasks involving observation, matching, and style choices. Each mini-game presents another short puzzle within the collection's creative makeover setting.

pages.title: TIny Football Cup 2026
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tiny Football Cup 2026 lets you guide a team through football matches and tournaments. Score against the opposition to earn game currency and diamonds, then unlock more leagues. Choose from twenty-eight teams or challenge friends in local multiplayer.

pages.title: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game is a timed strategy contest for territory against three rivals. Drag cards onto the battlefield to deploy units with different abilities. Finish among the top two for trophies and spend gold upgrading your available cards.

pages.title: Jigsolitaire
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Jigsolitaire asks you to rebuild pictures from movable image blocks. Drag a piece beside its correct neighbor and the two join automatically. Move the growing groups as well as individual blocks until the entire scene fits together.

pages.title: Energy Factory Idle
pages.creator: Crazy Pixel
pages.description: Energy Factory Idle lets you develop a small generator into a larger power-producing operation. Hire workers, increase production speed, improve output, and unlock additional generators. Offline rewards help fund further upgrades when you return to the factory.

pages.title: Last Ufo Defense
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Last Ufo Defense puts a lone UFO against continuing waves of hostile aliens. Survive the swarms while developing the hovering ship through upgrades. Your tactical choices determine how well it holds out as more enemies enter the battle.

pages.title: LOGic Slide
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: LOGic Slide is a sliding-log puzzle with beavers and sticky resin. Shift logs fully left or right to arrange them into a line across the river. Resin connects neighboring pieces, so consider how joined logs will affect later moves.

pages.title: Archery Legends
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Archery Legends challenges you to place arrows accurately on target. Adjust your aim for the bullseye and work through the shooting tasks. Classic and Adventure modes offer different ways to test your accuracy across the levels.

pages.title: Grocery Shop: Supermarket Game
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Grocery Shop puts you in charge of running and expanding a supermarket. Keep shelves stocked, manage inventory, and set prices for the goods customers need. Use the shop's earnings to grow the business and support more sales.

pages.title: Unblock it Atlantis
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Unblock It Atlantis turns block removal into a three-dimensional puzzle. Rotate the structure to inspect it, then slide blocks outward in their marked directions when the route is clear. Remove accessible pieces to open paths for the ones inside.

pages.title: Merge Fellas Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Merge Fellas Online lets you drop meme characters into a merging puzzle. Bring matching characters together to create their next form and increase your score. Choose where to release each piece so useful combinations remain available.

pages.title: Perfect Cake Maker
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Perfect Cake Maker asks you to prepare cakes according to guests' requests. Choose a suitable cake base and combine the ingredients for the order. Follow each customer's preferences as you assemble another dessert for the celebration.

pages.title: Goal Rush
pages.creator: Tejas Shrimali
pages.description: Goal Rush is a neon-styled football duel against the computer or a friend. Control your player, defend your goal, and look for a chance to score. Changing arena layouts and obstacles add complications to the one-on-one matches.

pages.title: Stickman in space
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Stickman Space follows an astronaut trying to escape from the Moon. Choose items to deal with threats such as aliens and meteors, then watch the result of each decision. Discover the successful routes among the story's possible outcomes.

pages.title: NoobHood HalloweenCraft
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: NoobHood HalloweenCraft sends a mounted hero through a Halloween forest. Collect coins, jump over obstacles, and use the sword against dangers along the path. Double jumps provide extra reach when a single leap will not get you through.

pages.title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Coloring by Numbers Pixel Rooms lets you reveal room and house illustrations one numbered area at a time. Match the colors to their indicated sections and fill in the picture. Continue until the interiors and decorative details form a finished image.

pages.title: Blastify II
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Blastify II is a color-block puzzle with targets to meet on each board. Tap groups of matching blocks to remove them and work toward the required totals. Four available boosters can help when the remaining arrangement becomes difficult.

pages.title: Royal Jigsaw
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Royal Jigsaw takes you through a kingdom of illustrated puzzle scenes. Fit the scattered pieces together to restore landscapes, castles, and other royal locations. Each completed picture opens another part of the journey to assemble.

pages.title: Bottle Shoot
pages.creator: Advergame Technologies Private Limited
pages.description: Bottle Shoot is an aiming challenge about hitting bottles with your shots. Watch their positions and fire when your aim is lined up. Keeping your timing accurate helps you continue breaking targets as the shooting challenge develops.

pages.title: Winter Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Winter Connect asks you to remove identical winter-themed tiles in pairs. A valid connection must have a clear path with no more than two turns. Clear the board before time expires by opening routes to the less accessible pieces.

pages.title: Draw and Save Stickman
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Draw Save Stickman makes your drawn lines a defense against hazards. Look at the danger threatening the stickman and sketch a shape that shields him. Test whether the barrier keeps the character safe from the scene's traps.

pages.title: Jewel Treasure
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Jewel Treasure is a gem-matching puzzle built around reaching target scores. Rearrange jewels to make matches of three and collect points from the cleared pieces. Plan useful moves to meet each level's requirement and advance.

pages.title: Kong Climb
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Kong Climb sends an ape upward along skyscrapers. Time the jumps to keep climbing and avoid losing your place. Collect bananas for added strength and chili peppers for a burst of speed on the way up.

pages.title: Real Bus Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Bus Simulator 3D combines bus driving with passenger stops, parking, and stunt challenges. Follow the route between stations and control the bus through each task. Earn gold as you complete the driving assignments.

pages.title: Word Search Animals
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Word Search Animals hides animal names among a grid of letters. Scan the rows and other available directions for each listed word, then mark it when found. Keep searching until every animal on the list has been located.

pages.title: Square dash
pages.creator: Alex White
pages.description: Square Dash is a reflex game about moving around obstacles with a square. Tap to change its direction at the right moment and find a safe route forward. Keep the run going to build a higher score.

pages.title: Zombie Last Castle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Last Castle puts you on defense as zombie waves approach a building. Fight them alone or with a second player, collect power-ups, and improve your weapons. Hold the position through the attacks to protect the castle.

pages.title: Two Aliens Adventure 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Two Aliens Adventure 2 has you control two aliens on opposite sides of the screen at once. Collect their colored diamonds, obtain keys, and bring both characters to the matching exits. Plan movements that keep both aliens safe across thirty stages.

pages.title: Jack O Gunner
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Jack O Gunner is a Halloween survival shooter against approaching skeletons. Drag to move the hero through the battle and keep fighting the surrounding enemies. Upgrade your abilities as you work to survive longer against the undead attackers.

pages.title: Save The Bear
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Save The Bear is a physics rescue puzzle built around cutting ropes. Release suspended objects in a useful order and guide the character toward the doorway. Check the positions of traps and dangerous objects before making a cut.

pages.title: Super Drive
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Super Drive gives you supercars to take around a city driving area. Explore the streets, build speed, and experiment with stunts in the open environment. Watch the surrounding roads and pedestrians while trying out the cars' handling.

pages.title: Jump Dunk 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Jump Dunk 3D combines a jumping stickman with a basketball shooting contest. Time throws while airborne and try to score three goals before the competition. Use the glass for a bank shot when a direct throw is difficult.

pages.title: Cannon Ball + Pop It Fidget
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Cannon Ball + Pop It Fidget lets you solve ball-launching puzzles and unlock fidget toys. Aim the cannon to complete challenges and earn stars. Spend your progress on more pop-it designs, with different colors and popping sounds to try.

pages.title: Mega City Missions
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Mega City Missions offers car racing and career challenges with seven vehicles to choose from. Complete missions, take on races, and customize your cars in the garage. A two-player option lets another driver share the city action.

pages.title: Rolling The Ball
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Rolling Ball asks you to get a ball into the hole with a single move. Study the route before committing to the shot. A carefully chosen direction lets the ball travel through the puzzle and finish on target.

pages.title: Grid Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Grid Blocks Puzzle lets you place shaped blocks to complete rows or columns. The pieces themselves cannot rotate, but you can rotate or invert the grid to change your options. Use that extra control to make room for later placements.

pages.title: Rage Road Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Rage Road Online turns a vehicle chase into a shooting challenge. Aim at the pursuing enemies and fire to stop them as the action moves along the road. Clear the opposition to complete the current level and continue the chase.

pages.title: Charge Through Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Charge Through Racing sends you down tracks with moving obstacles and coins to collect. Control your speed and time your approach to each hazard. A clear opening gives you the chance to pass through and keep the car moving.

pages.title: Frozen Princess Christmas Celebration
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Frozen Princess Christmas Celebration lets you prepare a festive day with Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, and Jack. Decorate a snowman and Christmas tree, then choose clothing for the characters. Combine the activities to finish their holiday preparations.

pages.title: Ski Jump
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Ski Jump challenges you to manage the takeoff, flight posture, and landing of a ski jumper. Start the approach, launch at the right moment, and adjust position in the air. Different modes and fifty-five hills provide further jumps to attempt.

pages.title: Halloween Word Search
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Halloween Word Search hides seasonal words in a letter grid. Study the listed terms, find their letter sequences, and mark each match. Complete the word list to finish the puzzle among the Halloween decorations.

pages.title: Bathroom clean and Deco
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bathroom Clean and Deco combines a cleaning task with room decoration. Clear the bathroom's mess and work through the cleaning steps, then choose new fixtures and decorative options. Arrange the refreshed room into a look of your own.

pages.title: Pool 8 Ball
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Pool 8 Ball offers an eight-ball pool table for solo or shared play. Aim your shots with the mouse or touch controls and work through the familiar pool rules. Play against a timer or take turns with someone on the same device.

pages.title: Ready Driver
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Ready Driver challenges you to survive traffic that can change lanes unexpectedly. Tap to move your own car into another lane and avoid vehicles or road obstacles. Keep watching the traffic ahead so a sudden move does not catch you out.

pages.title: Puzzle Color
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Puzzle Color asks you to fit blocks into empty areas while matching their colored edges. Move a piece into position and check the colors along all four sides. Complete the arrangement without leaving neighboring blocks with incompatible edges.

pages.title: Cute Penguin Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cute Penguin Slide lets you rebuild penguin pictures by sliding their scrambled tiles. Choose from three images and three puzzle modes, then move the pieces toward their correct arrangement. Use the picture details to work out where each section belongs.

pages.title: Pin Circle
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Pin Circle challenges you to launch needles into a spinning wheel without hitting ones already attached. Watch its changing speed and release each shot into a clear gap. Every added needle leaves less space for the remaining attempts.

pages.title: Drake Jigsaw
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Drake Jigsaw gives you a picture to reconstruct from scattered jigsaw pieces. Look for matching edges and recognizable details, then move the pieces into position. Keep building connected sections until the full image is restored.

pages.title: Pipe Ninja
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pipe Ninja is an arcade score challenge centered on staying attached to a pipe. Control your movement with the mouse and keep the run going for as long as possible. Each attempt gives you another chance to improve your score.

pages.title: Egg Helix
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Egg Helix challenges you to guide a bouncing egg through a tower of platforms. Rotate the structure to line up its next landing and continue toward the finish. Diamonds along the route provide an extra collection target.

pages.title: Vampires And Frankenstein Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Vampires And Frankenstein Coloring offers eight monster-themed pictures to color. Choose from twenty-three shades and fill the outlined artwork with your own combinations. Save a picture when you have finished, then try a different image or palette.

pages.title: Aliens In Space Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Aliens In Space Hidden is a memory game about finding matching picture cards. Flip two tiles, remember what they show, and look for identical pairs. Clear all the cards across four levels while trying to keep your move count low.

pages.title: Ram vs Ravan
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Ram vs Ravan is an action platform game inspired by the Ramayana rescue story. Guide Ram through the route and fight enemies with bow or sword attacks. Use movement and jumps to get past the obstacles on the journey.

pages.title: Cake Decorating
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Cake Decorating lets you design a cake using the available decorative items. Choose frosting colors and toppings, then combine them into your preferred arrangement. Experiment with the options to create a dessert with its own finished look.

pages.title: Cups and Balls
pages.creator: Almanac Group
pages.description: Cups and Balls tests whether you can follow a hidden ball through a shuffle. Watch the cup covering it, track the movement, and select its final position. The shuffling becomes harder as you continue making correct guesses.

pages.title: Vox Shooting
pages.creator: Jake & M3nto
pages.description: Vox Shooting sends waves of enemies and bosses toward you in a shooting arena. Move to avoid being overwhelmed, aim at the attackers, and pick up weapons or temporary upgrades. Keep fighting as more waves return to the battlefield.

pages.title: Parthian Warrior
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Parthian Warrior is a combat game with two maps and a selection of weapons, including a shield. Move into range for attacks, block incoming blows, and choose between regular and heavy strikes. Rolls and jumps provide additional ways to maneuver.

pages.title: Mummy Candies
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Mummy Candies asks you to gather sweets for a mummy while avoiding explosive pumpkins. Collect the candies and lollipops required by each stage, then use the shop to improve your chances. Twenty levels introduce increasingly difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Love Balloons
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Love Balloons is a block-clearing puzzle about opening a way for balloons to fly. Select groups of at least three matching blocks to remove them. Plan ahead to avoid leaving isolated pieces, and finish quickly for a better score.

pages.title: Spaceship Race
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Spaceship Race sends a craft along a hazardous course filled with barriers and moving obstacles. Guide it through clear openings and collect coins along the way. Keep the ship on its route while reacting to the next set of dangers.

pages.title: Animal Guessing
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Animal Guessing is a timed recognition game built around concealed animal shapes. Examine the shape and choose its name from the available answers. Correct responses reveal the animal and add to your progress before the time runs out.

pages.title: Deep Sea Fishing
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Deep Sea Fishing takes a penguin on a fishing trip for an aquarium. Catch fish and other small sea creatures using the mouse-controlled activity. Continue collecting animals to bring more underwater life back to the penguin's tank.

pages.title: Spooky Cupcakes
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Spooky Cupcakes guides you through making a Halloween dessert. Follow the cooking steps to prepare cranberry-flavored cupcakes, then add decorations for a spooky appearance. Work through the recipe until the finished batch is ready to present.

pages.title: BMW 530 MLE Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: BMW 530 MLE Puzzle offers six pictures of the car as jigsaw challenges. Choose a sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one-hundred-piece puzzle and fit the scattered parts together. Increase the piece count when you want a more detailed challenge.

pages.title: Piggy Bank Adventure2
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Piggy Bank Adventure 2 is a rope-cutting puzzle about sending coins into a piggy bank. Choose which ropes to cut and when to release the coin. Arrange its path to collect stars before it reaches the target.

pages.title: Luxury Sports Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Luxury Sports Cars Puzzle turns six sports-car pictures into jigsaw puzzles. Select an image and a piece count, then drag the sections into their correct positions. Four difficulty options let you choose between a short puzzle and a larger assembly.

pages.title: Cutie Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Cutie Girl Dress Up lets you customize a girl's appearance across clothing, hair, and color options. Try dresses, shirts, jeans, and shoes, then adjust details such as lips or nails. Combine the selections into a style you like.

pages.title: Frontline
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Frontline is a space defense game about holding off enemy ships and bosses. Choose available spacecraft, improve them through evolution, and buy upgrades in the shop. Strengthen your fleet as you work through the combat levels.

pages.title: EG Brick Out
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Brick Out challenges you to clear arrangements of bricks by keeping a ball in play. Move the paddle to return it toward the blocks and catch falling power-ups. Break the remaining bricks to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Cute Zoo
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Cute Zoo puts you in charge of helping young zoo animals. Heal, wash, and feed creatures such as a tiger cub, elephant, or penguin. Take part in their individual play activities after working through the care tasks.

pages.title: PineApplePen Deluxe
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: PineApplePen Deluxe is a fruit-shooting challenge about placing accurate hits. Aim at the fruit and release a shot when it is lined up. Keep adjusting your timing and aim to connect with the next target.

pages.title: EG Color Jump
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Color Jump asks you to react to the color of the next platform. Tap left or right to make the correct jump and keep the character moving. Collect gems for new characters, but a wrong choice ends the attempt.

pages.title: HidJigs Spring
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: HidJigs Spring combines hidden-object scenes with jigsaw puzzles. Choose a mode, then either search the spring pictures for concealed items or rebuild them from pieces. Try to improve your completion time as you revisit the challenges.

pages.title: Hot Charming Bride
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Hot Charming Bride lets you prepare a bride for her wedding appearance. Work on her makeover, then choose a dress and coordinating pieces for the ceremony. Try different combinations to finish the look before her arrival.

pages.title: Wasteland Shooters
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Wasteland Shooters is a multiplayer shooter with Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes. Fight across four maps using weapons ranging from pistols to launchers. Fast movement and high jumps give you ways to reposition during battles with other players.

pages.title: Xmas Magic Tiles
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Xmas Magic Tiles is a Christmas-themed music game about tapping green tiles accurately. Follow the incoming pattern and avoid missing a tile. Keep the sequence going to extend your performance along with the holiday soundtrack.

pages.title: Graduation Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Graduation Hairstyles lets you help a student finish her look before receiving her diploma. Choose and arrange a hairstyle to go with the graduation occasion, then select a suitable outfit. Prepare her appearance for the ceremony.

pages.title: Fun Sisters Night
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fun Sisters Night follows Elsa, Anna, and Rapunzel through a night of shared activities. Join the characters as they play their planned games. Use the mouse or touch controls to work through the evening's interactive scenes.

pages.title: 3 Marker Challenge
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: 3 Marker Challenge is a coloring game built around a limited selection of marker colors. Use the color-selection activity, then apply the available shades to a drawing. Combine the colors creatively to finish your entry for the challenge.

pages.title: Puppet Football Fighters
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Puppet Football Fighters combines football shots with attacks against rival puppet players. Aim kicks, score, and defeat the opposing character in the arena. Collect cards and upgrade the team as you work through further matches.

pages.title: 1000 Cookies
pages.creator: Star Mill B.V.
pages.description: 1000 Cookies is a block-placement puzzle using cookie shapes. Drag pieces into the grid to complete lines, which disappear and free more space. Plan the placements carefully, because the round ends when no remaining piece can fit.

pages.title: Star vs Evil Avatar Maker
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Star vs Evil Avatar Maker lets you create an avatar inspired by Star Butterfly's magical world. Choose appearance options and combine the available styling pieces. Experiment with the character design until the finished avatar has the look you want.

pages.title: Couple Autumn Trends
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Couple Autumn Trends lets you prepare Elsa and Jack for an autumn walk in the park. Pick an outfit for Elsa first, then choose clothing for Jack. Coordinate their seasonal looks before the couple heads outside.

pages.title: Mermaid Vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Mermaid Vs Princess gives the same character two different styles to try. Dress her as a mermaid and as a princess for their respective occasions. Compare the completed outfits and decide which version you prefer.

pages.title: Gooey Yama
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Gooey Yama follows a hungry blob through an obstacle-filled route. Help Yama jump over the dangers and reach the food along the way. Time each leap so the search for another snack does not end in a collision.

pages.title: Jelly Madness
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Jelly Madness is a match-three puzzle game filled with colorful jelly pieces. Look for matching combinations and clear them from the board. Work through the changing arrangements to keep progressing in the jelly-themed challenges.
